summary: Arbe Robotics Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing warrant amendment agreements executed September 25, 2026 with holders of all outstanding Tranche A and Tranche B ordinary share purchase warrants, each covering up to 8,131,866 shares (16,263,732 total). The amendments cut the Tranche A exercise price to $1.10 and extend termination to November 4, 2030, and cut the Tranche B exercise price to $1.00 with termination extended to November 4, 2029, conditioned on holder participation in a concurrent Form F-3 offering. Watch for the offering's pricing and size, dilution from exercised warrants, and any resale overhang.
